notes: Dev RBox expansion paired with biology-replace-d006 ('is adjacent to' edited to asymmetric): the made-up relation threlved_to is given asymmetry, the property the revision brings in, applied to real instances in the prompt. Own questions: the direct question (yes), the instance in Chinese and Spanish (no), the propositional forms. The instances are real neighbouring bones (scaphoid and lunate in the wrist, talus and navicular in the ankle), which are adjacent both ways, so a model that reads the coined word as 'adjacent' answers against the edit and only the inserted property gives the answers. The coined term stays untranslated. Unrelated near: whether, if one bone is adjacent to another, the second is never adjacent to the first (no; a leak of asymmetry to the real relation would make it yes). hops counts the prompt fact as one bridge (hops 2). Unrelated far: whether a cousin relation runs both ways, asked as an instance (yes).
